props.gloss_en: one may not place a vessel under a hen to receive its egg
but one may overturn a vessel over it [the egg] so it does not break
a hen usually lays its egg on the dump, and does not usually lay it on a slope
a common rescue they permitted
an uncommon rescue they did not permit
if his barrel of tevel broke on his roof, he brings a vessel and places it beneath it
one may place a vessel under the lamp to receive sparks
one may overturn a bowl over the lamp so that it does not catch the beam
a beam that broke -- one props it with a bench or with the long sides of a bed
one may place a vessel under a leak on Shabbat
[placing a vessel under the hen is forbidden] because he negates a vessel's readiness
one may overturn a basket before chicks so that they climb on and off
[Rav Yosef] holds it [the basket] may be moved [so its readiness is not negated]
a baraita: it is forbidden to move it [the basket]
[the baraita forbidding it speaks] of when they are still on it
a baraita: even when they are no longer on it -- forbidden
R' Abbahu: [that baraita speaks of] when they were on it all through twilight
since it was set aside for twilight, it was set aside for the whole day
R' Yitzchak: just as one may not place a vessel under a hen to receive its egg, so one may not overturn a vessel over it so it does not break
a vessel may be moved only for the sake of something that may be moved on Shabbat
an egg laid on Shabbat or on Yom Tov may not be moved to cover a vessel with it or to prop the legs of a bed, but one may overturn a vessel over it so it does not break
one may spread mats over stones on Shabbat
one may spread mats over bricks on Shabbat
one may spread a mat over a beehive on Shabbat -- in sun because of the sun, in rain because of the rain
provided that he does not intend to trap
here we deal with [a hive] in which there is honey
it is needed only for those two honeycombs [left in the hive in the rainy season]
even though he thought of them [beforehand], [it is permitted] only provided that he does not intend to trap
the beehive baraita follows R' Shimon
the beehive baraita follows R' Yehuda
'provided he does not intend to trap' means he must not make it like a trap: he leaves them space so that they are not trapped of themselves
Rav Ashi: it says 'in sun because of the sun, in rain because of the rain' -- the days of Nisan and Tishrei, when there is sun, cold, rain and honey
one may make a partition for a corpse for the sake of the living
and one may not make a partition for a corpse for the sake of the dead

a corpse lying in the sun: two people come and sit beside it; hot from below, each brings a bed and sits on it; hot from above, they spread a mat over themselves; each stands his bed up, slips away and leaves -- and the partition is found made of itself
what is [Rav Huna's partition for the living]? -- the two-beds procedure
Shmuel: [a corpse lying in the sun] one turns it over from bed to bed
Rav: one places a loaf or an infant on it and moves it
moving [a thing] indirectly counts as moving
moving [a thing] indirectly does not count as moving
one does not rescue a corpse from a fire
R' Yehuda ben Lakish: I heard that one rescues a corpse from a fire

(entertained) the dispute of Rav and Shmuel is the tannaitic dispute over rescuing a corpse from fire: with a loaf or infant, why would the tanna kama forbid? without, why would R' Yehuda ben Lakish permit? so they must differ over indirect moving
since a man is agitated about his dead, if you do not permit him [to rescue it], he will come to extinguish [the fire]
the halakha follows R' Yehuda ben Lakish regarding the dead
